LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GnawedTreeBark.label: gnawed tree bark
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GnawedTreeBark.description: Rough bark has injured the mouth and digestive tract.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GnawedWall.label: gnawed wall plaster
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GnawedWall.description: Dust and rubble have kept the hunger at bay, at a heavy cost.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_OverGnawedWall.label: excess wall plaster
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_OverGnawedWall.description: Swallowed plaster has almost overwhelmed this small body's ability to function.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TemporaryShelterMark.label: temporary shelter
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TemporaryShelterMark.descr: This Ratkin visitor has been taken in by the colony temporarily.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_HiredWorkerMark.label: hired worker
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_HiredWorkerMark.descriptio: This Ratkin visitor is staying as a hired worker.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_DisasterRefugeeMark.label: famine refugee
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_DisasterRefugeeMark.descri: A Ratkin displaced by the Great Famine Year. Hungry and frail, they seek food and shelter.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GuanyinTuSatiety.label: Guanyin clay satiety
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GuanyinTuSatiety.descripti: Guanyin clay clumps in the stomach, suppressing hunger for a while but hindering digestion. Eating more makes the effects worse.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AbandonedEgg.label: soon to be abandoned
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AbandonedEgg.description: Moments ago they were arguing over who ate the most. Soon nobody will claim them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AbandoningMother.label: abandoning mother
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AbandoningMother.descripti: Unable to feed her children any longer, she has chosen to leave them here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ShatteredMother_Dying.desc: Her own children ate part of her body. She barely clings to life. She bears no grudge; she knows they were hungry.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ShatteredMother_Children.d: With no food left, they ate part of their mother and left the rest behind. They kept walking, not understanding what they had done.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarMother.label: begging mother
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarMother.description: She has not eaten for days, but saved the last food for her children. She begs only for enough to keep them alive.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarChild.label: begging with mother
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarChild.description: They stay close to their mother, frightened and hungry. They do not know why she brought them here, only that they must follow.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarGroupAdult.label: hungry refugee
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarGroupAdult.descripti: They have walked a long way and are faint with hunger. They want a little food before moving on.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarGroupChild.label: begging with the group
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarGroupChild.descripti: They follow the adults without knowing the destination. Their stomachs rumble, but they dare not stop.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefAdult.label: hungry thief
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefAdult.description: Desperate hunger has driven them to steal food. They do not want trouble, but see no other choice.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefChild.label: learning to steal
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefChild.description: They copy the adults. They do not understand theft, only that it brings food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefChildOnly.label: unattended young thief
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefChildOnly.description: With no adult to guide them, they learned to steal on their own. They know only that it keeps them alive.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LargeRefugeeAdult.label: refugee from the great wave
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LargeRefugeeAdult.descript: A survivor of the Great Famine Year, exhausted by a long journey and desperate for food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LargeRefugeeChild.label: child of the great wave
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LargeRefugeeChild.descript: They have followed the adults a long way and are desperately hungry. They understand little beyond the need to keep going.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_FamineRefugee.label: homeless famine refugee
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_FamineRefugee.description: The famine destroyed their home. They wander, frighteningly thin, but still alive.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildWanderer.label: wild Ratkin wanderer
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildWanderer.description: A starving Ratkin with no faction, roaming freely.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildChildWanderer.label: wild Ratkin child
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildChildWanderer.descript: A starving Ratkin child with no faction, roaming freely.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildGroupWanderer.label: wild Ratkin wanderers
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildGroupWanderer.descript: Starving Ratkin with no faction, roaming freely.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TraderCaravanTrader.label: refugee trader
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TraderCaravanTrader.descri: She brought captive Ratkin young to the edge of the colony and handles the trading.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TraderCaravanEscort.label: refugee caravan guard
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TraderCaravanEscort.descri: She protects the caravan and keeps the trade moving.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TraderCaravanChild.label: Ratkin young for sale
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_TraderCaravanChild.descrip: Traded like goods, they have no idea what will become of them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchangeTrader.label: child-exchange trader
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchangeTrader.descri: She brought Ratkin young to the edge of the colony to exchange them for babies.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchangeChild.label: Ratkin young for exchange
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchangeChild.descrip: They are about to be handed over, unaware of what awaits them.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_SiegeBeggar.label: besieging beggar
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_SiegeBeggar.description: They surround the colony and repeatedly beg for food rather than attacking outright.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GreatFamineAdult.label: frenzied famine Ratkin
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GreatFamineAdult.descripti: Hunger has driven this adult Ratkin beyond reason. They want to eat anything they can reach.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GreatFamineChild.label: frenzied Ratkin young
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GreatFamineChild.descripti: Hunger has driven this young Ratkin beyond reason. They want to gnaw anything they can reach.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Plague.label: Ratkin plague
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Plague.description: A virulent disease brought by the famine refugees. It worsens faster than flu.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Plague.stages.0.label: infected
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_FedOnce.label: fed
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_FedOnce.description: This visitor has completed their search for food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RefeedingSyndrome.label: refeeding syndrome
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RefeedingSyndrome.descript: A sudden large meal after prolonged starvation has disrupted the body's balance. Digestion, blood filtration and consciousness are temporarily reduced.
